plain: Paid back for money spent or lent

webster.text: Repaid; refunded; made good, as loss or expense.

example.quote: The lender would be sure of being reimbursed in time.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. WHITMILL HILL, July 26, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
